title: Right Triangle of Stars
description:
Print a right triangle of stars with 5 rows. Row 1 has 1 star, row 5 has 5 stars.

**Expected output:**
```
*
**
***
****
*****
```
starterCode: # Print a right triangle of stars with 5 rows
hint: Loop from 1 to 5 (inclusive) and print "*" * i each iteration.
